verdict.rationale: Runway documents native 1080p generation (Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0 at 720p/1080p, draft previews enhanced to 1080p), 4K upscaling, and in-product delivery formats such as ProRes, PNG sequences and HDR profiles, so resolution and delivery-format needs are covered without outside encoding. However, nothing in the evidence documents selectable 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 output. Ads publishing to Meta, Google and TikTok only implies channel-appropriate formats. Missing for 10: explicit aspect-ratio controls (16:9/9:16/1:1), per-model resolution/aspect matrix, independent hands-on confirmation of channel-ready exports.
